domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractions.
Tag when one or both fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag in both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items when the fractional parts are rewritten to a shared denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag simplification such as 4/10 to 2/5 unless it is being used specifically to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready standard form before carrying out the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is rewritten as an equivalent standard mixed number, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when an operand is simplified or reformatted before subtraction so that whole and fractional parts can be handled separately.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used to match denominators; that belongs to finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination or simplification of the answer.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when same-denominator fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when the same-denominator subtraction occurs after prior normalization, common-denominator conversion, or borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that finds or creates the common denominator.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction unless the subtraction itself is explicitly shown.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or rewritten whole numbers as part of the overall subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 = 1.
Tag when whole-part subtraction is performed alongside fraction-part subtraction in the same step.
Tag when a whole number is treated as the whole part of a mixed number and then subtracted.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number component.
Do not tag borrowing itself unless the step explicitly performs the whole-part subtraction.
Do not tag final combination statements that merely report the mixed-number result.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units when the minuend’s fractional part is too small to subtract the subtrahend’s fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when regrouping is used to resolve a negative fractional difference in mixed-number, whole-minus-fraction, or mixed-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is added to the existing fractional part before the fraction subtraction continues.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of a whole number or improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag the later fraction subtraction after borrowing unless the regrouping action itself is shown.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction result is reduced to lowest terms, such as 9/12 = 3/4 or 0/3 = 0.
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a final mixed number, integer, or single fraction.
Tag when the final answer form removes a zero whole part or zero fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that have not yet formed the final result.
Do not tag rewriting an operand before subtraction; that belongs to normalization.
